title: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint — Network Telemetry Visibility in Web Proxy / SWG Architectures (iboss, Zscaler, Loopback)
author_notes: Net-new: MDE network-telemetry coexistence with a loopback/forward proxy (iboss/Zscaler/generic SWG). Gap-deduped vs the Netskope line + the generic 'Endpoint Network Connectivity Troubleshooting Toolkit' (that is connectivity, this is telemetry visibility). Read-only assessment scripts (PowerShell Graph Security + KQL); NO changes to the proxy. Vendor (iboss/Zscaler) console internals + Microsoft's authoritative answers on affected tables / XFF support / supported topology are flagged 'confirm with Microsoft / verify against current guidance' — never asserted. Regulatory/architecture-acceptance decisions deferred to the customer's security/network owners.
